notes.title: Craft in Abyss, early access on September 4th
notes.content:
Firepillar's newest game - Craft in Abyss - will be going into early access on September 4th.
It is a base-building rogue-like game, where the player takes the role of an underwater engineer, who continuously upgrades and strengthens her warship as she gather more companions, and fight for more resources.
Craft in Abyss will inherit Nino Isekai's rogue-like excitement and fun, and also provides players with even more freedom to build the fortress of their dreams
The game will be sold for USD$10, and there will be a 10% discount for the first week.
If you're interested, make sure to wishlist the game so that you will get notified when the game is released.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255050/Craft_In_Abyss/

notes.title: We're preparing the 100 Positive Reviews Update
notes.content:
We promised to introduce a large number of new skills once we receive 100 positive comments before, and even though the playerbase seemed to have dwindled down, we haven't forgotten our promise. We're currently coming up with new ideas so that the game won't become more difficult or less new-player-friendly after we add more skills. We hope that this update will fulfill the needs of both old and new players. We're planning to launch the update during January 2020.
Also, just a reminder. The next update will be after we reach 150 positive reviews. We will make change some skills (such as the Focus skills) into passive ones into active ones.

notes.title: Update new content per 50 positive comments on Steam
notes.content:
We want to improve the game and we know this is going to require continuous effort. We are not professionals who can spend their entire day doing that. We want some encouragement to push us forward. In order to achieve that, we have decided that we will update the game every time we get an extra 50 positive Steam comments. This can not only help us advertise the game, but can also lead to a better game for players. Hopefully, this will bring about a win-win situation for all of us. (Of course, we will still do bug-fixes outside of these additional updates).

Milestone:

50 Positive Comments (Reached):
Talent balancing: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1078960/announcements/detail/1666821776716902571
Add German Language Option

100 Positive Comments (Unreached):
Introduce new skills (at least 30) related to:
Guaranteed Scale Sync
Increased Wet decay rate
Increased Burn decay rate
More Understanding talents (Effects gained when the deck is shuffled)
More Robust talents (Additional Scale Sync effects)
More Eye skills (Gaining additional effect stacks)
Decreasing stamina lost
Stun countermeasures
Other statuses such as Immunity, Healing, Special Attack, Lifesteal, Catalyst, Accelerant, Shuffle Fatigue, and Soften etc.

150 Positive Comments (Unreached)
Making some skills like the Stockpiled effects activated based on player decisions
Large number of additional policies
Improved achievement system
Improved rewards system

200 Positive Comments (Unreached)
Player stat tracker (e.g. highest damage in one hit, shortest game completion time etc.)

notes.title: Nino Isekai official relase!
notes.content:
[h1]JRPG-style story revolved around the concept of “time”[/h1]
Nino’s Isekai tells the story of Nino having died in the real world and is transported to another one. There, he is now a cult leader whose religious scripture is the Bible! As a Christian in his previous life, Nino wants to teach his new followers the right way and confront enemies to end the war. Unfortunately, Nino was cursed at the start of his journey. His lifespan was now presented by a few dozen fruits, which will be gradually consumed over the next three days. The game follows Nino over the course of these three days, during which the player will need to manage their time to help Nino break through the obstacles and complete his journey.

Main Feature
[list]
[*] A Heavy Focus on Time Limit and Resource Management
[*] Roguelike
[*] Active Time Battle
[/list]

Steam page： https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078960
Official Discord： https://discord.gg/ZerJwa2
Official Wiki： https://gamerch.com/ninoisekai/

notes.title: Full picture of the story
notes.content: Nino is a devoted Christian, but after he died, he didn't go to Heaven. Instead, he transmigrated to another world. Was this God's prank? Or was there another reason for this? Players, you will be able to experience Nino's full adventure as he discovers this new world.
